creative_direction.name: Blush Paper Contour Plaque
creative_direction.brief: A constructed paper sculpture: concentric die-cut blush paper layers stack into a soft topographic oval valley centred upper-middle, each cut edge casting a hairline shade so depth reads as contour lines behind the silhouette. The cutout is lifted into the upper two-thirds, standing out of the paper valley, while the lower third becomes a quiet plaque band: brand line, then the geometric sans name set wide and centred at near band width, closed by a thin rose rule floating between image and text like a cut edge. Layered matte card against glossy lacquer tells the story entirely through cut depth.
creative_direction.material: concentric die-cut layered paper cards in shifted blush tones
creative_direction.lighting: even diffuse frontal light with hairline shade under each cut edge, flat graphic illumination

background.prompt: Concentric die-cut layered paper cards in shifted blush rose tones forming a topographic oval valley centred upper middle, hairline soft shade under each cut edge, matte card fibre grain, even shadowless frontal illumination, no objects, no horizon
